display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (Supine): (Apneaswith >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal) / hour of sleep in supine position from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in supine body position (>= 2% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hrembp2 + hnrbp2 + carbp2 + canbp2 + oarbp2 + oanbp2 + marbp2 + manrbp2)/(remepbp+nremepbp)
